description: The recommendation rule for solution answers (lib/advice/recommend.ts): hard limits, then the customer's timing, then the lowest cost, with near ties going to a fixed rate. Run deterministically by lib/advice/recommend.test.ts over the routes of the chat.html renovation example (40,000 lei: Flexicredit 60 months chosen, 48 months, save 8 months then borrow 30,000). Each case overrides routes by key, the timing or the policy. No provider calls.

cases.scenario: Needs the money now: the chosen 60-month loan, with saving first as the cheaper route if it can wait
Can wait a year: saving first is cheapest and starts in time
Timing not given, and the cheapest route starts later: ask when they need it
Timing not given, but the cheapest route starts now: no question needed
Income and other payments unknown: ask, never guess affordability
The chosen term is over the debt share ceiling: another term of the same loan is picked, and it is not called the cheapest while saving first costs less
Every route over the ceiling: no recommendation
No ceiling stated by the bank: show the debt share, never claim it leaves room
A variable-rate overdraft only slightly cheaper than the fixed loan: the near tie goes to the fixed rate
An overdraft clearly cheaper and within limits: it is recommended
Nothing in the catalog backs any route: unavailable, no recommendation
A route leaves nothing each month: excluded even under the ceiling
